fill_rule_probe.finding: the 3/20 planted and 24/200 decoy plaintext differences of decoder_on_my_ciphers come from one implementation choice: B1_rederive lets a path take skips over wrapped key symbols (k[(j+t) mod K]) after the key budget is used up; the package allows no skip once j + s >= K (fill = one symbol per rune, reports/beam_decoder.md section 1). With that rule B1_rederive.beam_decode matches runeforge.beam.decode_batch path for path.
fill_rule_probe.effect_on_rule: none: package on the same ciphers gives 20/20 identified, median -3.7535, floor -4.1556 (identical to the independent numbers at 1e-8)
